page.overview:
Who is Abin Sur?

"In brightest day, in blackest night, No evil shall escape my sight. Let those who worship evil's might, Beware my power...Green Lantern's light!"

Abin Sur was a member of the Green Lantern Corps and the protector of Sector 2814.

While patrolling the sector, he is attacked and crash lands on Earth. With his dying breath, he gives his Green Lantern Ring to Hal Jordan, making him the first human in the Green Lantern Corps.

He currently resides in the Emerald Space, the "afterlife" for Green Lanterns who gave their life for the cause.
